seasonality: Year-round; peak Nov–Apr; humpback whale season Dec–Mar; rainy/hurricane season Jun–Oct (bay stays relatively protected).
summary: Puerto Vallarta and the Riviera Nayarit ring Banderas Bay, one of Mexico's largest bays, with a dense resort and charter market. Many of the bay's marquee spots — Yelapa, Las Ánimas, the Marietas islands, Punta de Mita, Sayulita — are reachable only or best by water, and all sit well inside Pioneer II range. Marina Vallarta and Nuevo Vallarta anchor the charter fleet. This is a strong Pioneer II coastal-mesh and excursion market.
tagline: Banderas Bay resort coast — dense short hops to Yelapa, Punta de Mita, the Marietas and Sayulita.
